text:
maria: Heads-up for overnight change window (2026-03-25 02:00 UTC). Plan: flip ff/llm-routing to model-v3. Need an owner for the ramp and clear abort criteria. Keep blast radius small.

release-bot: scheduled by @maria for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. CI build-2026-03-25-77 passed — https://ci.internal/builds/2026-03-25-77

sam: I can run the rollout. Proposed ramp: 0.5% (5m) -> 3% (10m) -> 20% (10m) -> 100%. Monitor error-rate, p99 latency, token-gen-time, and run the quick smoke set. I'll post each step here.

troy: Telemetry gates: abort if error-rate increases by >0.8% absolute OR p99 latency regresses by >300ms for 3m OR token-gen-time +20%. If any gate trips, immediate rollback and pin to v2.

ops-bot: created alert group "ff-modelv3-ramp" and notified @oncall.

sam: Ramp commands I'll use: 
```
ffctl set ff/llm-routing --weight 0.5 --cohort canary
ffctl set ff/llm-routing --weight 3
ffctl set ff/llm-routing --weight 20
ffctl set ff/llm-routing --weight 100
```
I'll run them stepwise and update status.

troy: Also run the warmup job before moving past 3%: 
```
infra run warmup --model model-v3 --workers 50
```
We should avoid cold-start tail latency.

maria: No other infra or feature changes during ramp. If component-B latency regresses >15% for >5m, abort. Rollback runbook in /runbooks/rb-llm-v3.md.

sam: 0.5% stable after 6m, moving to 3%. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: alert: p99 latency increased by 320ms at cohort=3% — exceeds threshold.

troy: aborting ramp based on telemetry. Sam, please run rollback.

sam: Running rollback now.
```
ffctl set ff/llm-routing --weight 0
ffctl pin ff/llm-routing --version v2 --expires 12h
release-bot notify --context "ramp-abort model-v3 p99-latency"
```

ops-bot: rollback commands executed; ff/llm-routing pinned to v2. Alerts in ff-modelv3-ramp closed.

maria: Thanks. I'll file a short incident note and schedule a follow-up for model-v3 with improved warmup and a smaller step size. Please add a preflight perf test for model-level token-gen time.

troy: Agreed — add soft step cap (max +5% per step) to rollout tool to prevent big QPS jumps.

sam: Thanks all. Will re-run after warmup improvements. Reopening thread when ready.
